integrity: All integer bounds in the new attainment and Pareto efficiency proof are analytical. Finite checks verify samples, not the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Theorem applies exclusively to the specified four-agent, nine-good parametric family; the strict upper bound is imported from arXiv:2610.29201v1, Theorem 2. Independent scientific audit remains unperformed.
title: Sharp attainable approximate-EFX threshold for a nine-good Pareto obstruction
